name: Complete Cable Company LLC
old_description: Complete Cable Company LLC manufactures custom wire harnesses and cable assemblies for OEM applications across a wide range of industries. We support customers from prototype development through repeat production with a focus on quality, responsiveness, and dependable lead times.
about:
Complete Cable Company LLC is a family-owned manufacturer of custom wire harnesses and cable assemblies based in St. Joseph, Michigan. The company is led by co-owners Rob Kasun and Jon Kasun, who oversee business operations, production, and quality execution. Founded as a Michigan-based operation, the business focuses on build-to-print manufacturing for OEM customers.

The company produces wire harnesses and cable assemblies from prototype through repeat production, handling wire cutting, stripping, crimping, and assembly for gauges ranging from 14 to 22 AWG with PVC and SRPVC insulation. Additional capabilities include cable routing, bundling, labeling, kitting, and the manufacture of custom test harnesses for validation and production support. Every assembly undergoes 100% continuity and hi-pot testing on a Cirris 4250 tester, with results traceable to each production run.

Complete Cable serves the automotive, appliance manufacturing, industrial equipment, and electromechanical systems sectors, providing OEM assemblies built to customer specifications. The company supports engineering and production teams with rapid prototype builds and validation test support.

The company emphasizes responsive quoting—typically within 48 business hours—expedited prototype options, and direct access to ownership for fast decisions. A small, agile team manages process-controlled assembly with documented inspection, aiming to reduce rework and maintain dependable lead times based on material availability.
